jobs.title: Software Engineer (Data Engineering C# .NET)
jobs.description:
About Aqovia

At Aqovia, we don’t just build software, we engineer impact. We are an international technology firm and strategic incubator creating real-world value through AI, data, and bespoke software solutions across fintech, healthcare, and sustainability.

We live and breathe agile and eXtreme Programming. We advocate for clean code, continuous integration, pair programming, and an AI-first mindset to software development.

The Role

We are looking for a Back-End Data Engineer
to join our agile team. Operating at an SFIA 3 level, you will focus on building robust back-end microservices, high-performance data pipelines, managing MS SQL platforms, and implementing enterprise ETL solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Back-End & API Development: Design, build, and maintain back-end services, RESTful APIs, and microservices using C#, .NET, and NodeJS.
Data Engineering & ETL: Develop data pipelines, MS SQL database schemas, and enterprise ETL/ELT processes.
Integration & Streaming: Connect back-end applications to event-driven architectures using RabbitMQ or Azure Service Bus.
AI & DevOps: Leverage modern AI tooling to streamline workflows, automate deployments via CI/CD, and monitor application health.

What We’re Looking For

Core Tech Stack: C#, .NET, NodeJS, and MS SQL Server (T-SQL, stored procedures, performance tuning).
Data Architecture: Hands-on experience with ETL workflows, data integration pipelines, and event-driven messaging (RabbitMQ or Azure Service Bus).
Cloud Infrastructure: Familiarity with Azure services (Azure Functions, Azure SQL).
Mindset: Proactive with AI tooling, comfortable with pair programming, and possessed of an entrepreneurial, problem-solving drive.

Why Join Us?

Culture: Collaborative eXtreme Programming environment, rapid career advancement, and an incubator culture where innovation is rewarded.
Benefits: Competitive salary, private healthcare, paid gym membership, pension scheme, Perkbox, and optional remunerated L2/L3 support.

Aqovia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Optimizely Developer
jobs.description:
Optimizely Developer

Spalding, Lincolnshire

£50,000 - £60,000 + Holiday + Pension

Are you an experienced Optimizely Developer looking to join a growing digital transformation consultancy where you will work on enterprise-level websites, cutting-edge digital platforms and customer experience solutions for a diverse portfolio of clients while further developing your expertise with modern Microsoft technologies?

This is an excellent opportunity to join an award-winning technology consultancy that delivers innovative software solutions to organisations across the UK. You'll play a key role in developing, customising and maintaining enterprise CMS solutions while collaborating with Business Analysts, Designers, Project Managers and fellow Developers.

In this hands-on role, you'll be involved throughout the full software development lifecycle, from technical design and estimation through to development, deployment and ongoing support. You'll work with technologies including C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server and Optimizely CMS to deliver scalable, secure and high-performing digital platforms.

The ideal candidate will have strong commercial experience with Optimizely CMS, C# and .NET development, along with experience building CMS-driven web applications and integrating third-party systems. Experience with Azure, Umbraco or modern headless architectures would be advantageous.

The Role

Design, develop and maintain websites and applications using Optimizely CMS
Develop scalable solutions using C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core and SQL Server
Build integrations with third-party APIs, enterprise systems and cloud services
Participate in technical design, estimation and solution architecture discussions
Support testing, deployments, documentation and ongoing platform enhancements

The Person

Commercial experience with Optimizely CMS, Episerver or Optimizely DXP
Strong C# and .NET development background
Experience with ASP.NET Core, MVC and REST APIs
Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and responsive web development
Understanding of CI/CD, source control and software development best practices
Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills
